title: Baked VoxelGIData and LightmapGIData is still exported in dedicated server exports
body: - *Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/109098 and https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12748.* ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.5.beta 2d113cc224cb9be07866d003819fcef2226a52ea ### System information Godot v4.5.beta (2d113cc22) - Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 575.64.03) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory ### Issue description Baked VoxelGIData and LightmapGIData is still exported in dedicated server exports. This unnecessarily increases the size of projects exported as dedicated servers, as these files can be pretty large in size when used for large levels. We can probably fix this by introducing PlaceholderVoxelGIData and PlaceholderLightmapGIData resources that inherit from VoxelGIData and LightmapGIData respectively, similar to PlaceholderTexture2D. These resources would only be there to allow the scene to load successfully (with no missing dependency errors), but would contain no actual GI data. ### Steps to reproduce - Export a ZIP pack of the project with the "Linux Server" export preset. - Open the ZIP archive and notice the VoxelGIData (`.VoxelGIData.res`) and LightmapGIData (`.lmbake`) is still there, and have the same file size with a standard Linux (non-server) export. Only the lightmap's `.exr` file is excluded. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [test_project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21518759/test_project.zip) Exported ZIPs for comparison: - [out_linux.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21518785/out_linux.zip) - [out_linux_server.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21518786/out_linux_server.zip)
